project.name: Chattera :: Platform :: Common Observability
project.description: Minimal shared observability auto-configuration: tags emitted Micrometer metrics with the owning service's spring.application.name so per-service dashboards/alerts can filter by "service" once a metrics backend is wired up (owned with devops-engineer). Logging/tracing config intentionally not added yet - keep this minimal until an actual tracing backend is chosen.
